Telescope 3.5 lets you switch off the parts of the desktop app you never use and add plugins other people made.

## New

**Plugins.** Most of the desktop app is made of plugins now: the Camera card, Transforms, Presets, the microphone, the wait screen, keyboard shortcuts and a few more. **Plugins…** in the settings menu lists them all with a line about what each one does. Untick one you don't need and Telescope first tells you what will be missing without it. Nothing gets deleted (its settings are still there when you switch it back on). Changes apply after a restart and the dialog has a **Restart now** button for that.

**Installing plugins.** **Install plugin…** in the same dialog takes a plugin someone shared as a `.zip`, or you can drag the file onto the window. New plugins start out switched off and Telescope warns you before you turn one on, since a plugin can do anything Telescope itself can on your computer. If a plugin's files change after you switched it on it gets switched off again until you say it's fine. One that breaks while starting is left out and a banner tells you which one it was while the rest of Telescope starts as usual.

**Writing your own.** If you know a little Python you can make a plugin without learning the rest of Telescope first. [Plugins](https://github.com/LunarKittyy/Telescope/blob/master/docs/plugins.md) has a small example to copy and explains how to try it out while you work on it. If you try making one and the docs left you guessing somewhere please open an issue about that too. I'd like writing plugins to be a nice experience and not a puzzle.

## Changed

- The portable Windows download is now called `Telescope-windows-portable.zip`. Copies unzipped from the old `Telescope-windows.zip` still find this update.

## Behind the scenes

Making plugins possible meant taking a big part of the desktop app apart and putting it back together more carefully. The parts now go through a small fixed set of calls instead of reaching into one another's code and tests make sure Telescope still starts with any one of them left out. You won't notice any of this while using Telescope (and you don't need to care about it). I still wanted to mention it because I care about what's under the hood too and want this project to stay nice to build on instead of slowly turning into a pile of everything.

The phone app has no changes in this release.

Found something broken? Open an issue and paste your **Copy diagnostics** report into it.
